verdict.rationale: EBANX documents tracking of available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history (ebanx-docs-4), and markets "unified reconciliation" for recurring payments (ebanx-docs-34). Neither item shows these are exposed as API endpoints or that settlements can be broken down to their underlying charges, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm it. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for settlement/balance-transaction data, per-deposit breakdown linking each bank deposit to its underlying charges, agent-oriented guidance for reconciliation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
